## Goal
`BETA.DIST(x,a,b,FALSE)` with a, b > 1 and n = a + b - 2 from 90 to 256 is within 15 digits of Excel's value on the
3,417 probes-numeric cells listed below, with no new visibly-off cell.

## Context
- Decision 0188 R5 (owner's 2026-10-31 rulings): parked as Phase 1b. Every cell this task owns is a BETA.DIST or
  F.DIST density cell or a dense probes-numeric sweep cell, within Gate A's envelope (most agree with Excel to 12 or
  more digits, and Excel and the engine are both close to the math), so R1(c) counts it as Phase 1b evidence. A
  point that Gate A's tables show outside the envelope gets its own task without the key.
- Gap triage 2026-10-30c (`make eval` on main 40ca52179, excel-graph; `python3 scripts/exit_owners.py --all-off`,
  also run against the task files of every unmerged branch). These cells were visibly off before T-2507's Loader port
  and still are. T-2507 (done) owned them; T-3220 owns only the 661 cells the port newly moved off
  (docs/research/t2507/newly_visibly_off.tsv). The 174 cells of the F-density probe's BETA.DIST column were owned
  only by T-2821, which is `defer: phase-1b`, so they had no Phase 1 owner.
- Shapes (a, b), cells, sd of (ours - Excel) in units of 2^-52 relative: (100, 120) 931 sd 15; (100.5, 157.5) 815
  sd 19; (150, 90) 576 sd 18; (60.5, 67.5) 275 sd 9; (40.7, 55.3) 235 sd 8; (40.25, 89.75) 230 sd 10; (50, 50) 174
  sd 15; (45.2, 60.9) 118 sd 0.5; 9 more shapes with 2-38 cells each. Within a shape the miss varies with x. The one
  exception is (45.2, 60.9), a constant offset of +5.3 units, which is the Loader constant's residue (T-2586 item 1).
  So most of this is the x-dependent part: bd0 and the exponent. The sd grows with n, as on T-3250's a = 1025 column.
- Stage `visible`. On 300-cell samples against 200-bit mpmath, Excel is a median 21 ulp (p90 74) from the correctly
  rounded density on the bd0 run probe and the engine 14 (p90 67). On the bd0 hold-out probe the figures are 22
  (p90 62) and 17 (p90 49). So Excel is the inaccurate one.
- Evidence and model: docs/excel-semantics/statistics.md "Beta density for min(a,b) > 1 is Loader's saddle point"
  (the series branch's 3-41 units of structured noise and the series/log-form offset are UNVERIFIED there).
  docs/research/t2464/r3-loader-bd0 and r3-loader-const have the libraries (`r3lib.py`), and the verify-r3-* reports
  override worker claims. The verifier's probes are the hold-out: fit on the others, score once on them (decision
  0056, time-boxed). Code: `crates/rustsheet-engine/src/functions/statistical/loader.rs` (`excel_bd0`,
  `excel_bd0_series`, `excel_beta_density`).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The listed cells are within 15 digits of Excel's value, or each one left over is named here with its reason
      and an owner.
- [ ] No new visibly-off cell in any suite. T-2507's fixed cells, T-3220's and T-3250's cells, and the
      min(a,b) <= 1 densities keep their verdicts. The known-failure lines in eval/baseline/probes-numeric.txt only
      shrink, and the ironcalc-calc BETA.DIST lines do not grow.
- [ ] statistics.md's Loader entry records the piece found, with its hold-out score (exact, 4 ulp and 15 digits, and
      CR on the same rows), or the negatives tried. The series branch's UNVERIFIED status changes only on hold-out
      evidence.
- [ ] `make check` green; reviewers approve.

## Out of scope
- n < 90 (T-3220), the a = 1025 column and shapes above n = 256 (T-3250), min(a,b) <= 1 (T-2503, T-2821, T-3035).
- The cdf (incomplete beta tasks).

## Visible-parity stage
Target (decision 0114): every cell above within half a unit of the 15th significant digit of Excel's value. Bit-level
residue goes to a follow-up with `defer: phase-1b`.
